lines.text_uz: Yutilish 0,486. Bu qanday konsentratsiya?
lines.text_en_reference: Absorbance 0.486. What concentration is that?
lines.text_tts: Yutilish nol vergul to‘rt yuz sakson olti. Bu qanday konsentratsiya?

lines.text_uz: Kalibrlashsiz buni hech kim ayta olmaydi.
lines.text_en_reference: Without a calibration, nobody can say.

suggested.note: shorter wording of the same statement; owner / native review required; burned-in subtitles still show the long text unless lines.uz.json is changed too

lines.text_uz: Analizatorda nur reaksiya kyuvetasidan o‘tadi, fotometr yutilishni o‘lchaydi.
lines.text_en_reference: In the analyzer, light passes through the reaction cuvette; the photometer measures absorbance.
lines.text_tts: Analizatorda nur reaksiya kyuvetasidan o‘tadi, fotometr yutilishni o‘lchaydi.

lines.text_uz: Konsentratsiya so‘ng kalibrlash bo‘yicha hisoblanadi.
lines.text_en_reference: The concentration is then calculated from a calibration.
lines.text_tts: Konsentratsiya so‘ng kalibrlash bo‘yicha hisoblanadi.

lines.text_uz: Nur qancha ko‘p yutilsa, detektorga shuncha kam yetadi — yutilish esa ortadi.
lines.text_en_reference: More light absorbed means less reaches the detector — and a higher absorbance.
lines.text_tts: Nur qancha ko‘p yutilsa, detektorga shuncha kam yetadi, yutilish esa ortadi.

suggested.text_uz: Nur ko‘p yutilsa, detektorga kam yetadi — yutilish ortadi.
suggested.text_tts: Nur ko‘p yutilsa, detektorga kam yetadi, yutilish ortadi.
suggested.note: shorter wording of the same statement; owner / native review required; burned-in subtitles still show the long text unless lines.uz.json is changed too

lines.text_uz: Kalibratorlarning belgilangan qiymati bor; har daraja bitta signal beradi.
lines.text_en_reference: Calibrators have assigned values; each level gives one signal.
lines.text_tts: Kalibratorlarning belgilangan qiymati bor; har daraja bitta signal beradi.

lines.text_uz: Yutilishni konsentratsiyaga qarab nuqtama-nuqta belgilaymiz.
lines.text_en_reference: Plot absorbance against concentration, point by point.
lines.text_tts: Yutilishni konsentratsiyaga qarab nuqtama-nuqta belgilaymiz.

lines.text_uz: Eng kichik kvadratlar usulidagi chiziq — kalibrlash egri chizig‘i.
lines.text_en_reference: A least-squares line through the points is the calibration curve.
lines.text_tts: Eng kichik kvadratlar usulidagi chiziq, kalibrlash egri chizig‘i.

suggested.text_uz: Eng kichik kvadratlar chizig‘i — kalibrlash egrisi.

lines.text_uz: Qiyalik, ozod had va R² shu nuqtalardan hisoblangan.
lines.text_en_reference: Slope, intercept and R² are computed from these points.
lines.text_tts: Qiyalik, ozod had va er kvadrat shu nuqtalardan hisoblangan.

suggested.text_uz: Qiyalik, ozod had, R² nuqtalardan hisoblangan.
suggested.text_tts: Qiyalik, ozod had, er kvadrat nuqtalardan hisoblangan.

lines.text_uz: Maqsadli qiymati ma’lum nazorat egri chiziqdan o‘qiladi.
lines.text_en_reference: A control with a known target is read off the curve.
lines.text_tts: Maqsadli qiymati ma’lum nazorat egri chiziqdan o‘qiladi.

lines.text_uz: Faqat R² yetarli emas: qoldiqlar kichik va tendensiyasiz bo‘lsin.
lines.text_en_reference: R² alone is not enough: residuals should be small, with no trend.
lines.text_tts: Faqat er kvadrat yetarli emas: qoldiqlar kichik va tendensiyasiz bo‘lsin.
